title: The Gravity of Station Meridian
author: F. M. Okafor
blurb: Vesper Hartwell, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
